findings.description: One entry per problem. Empty array means no blockers found.

id.description: Stable id inside this report, e.g. F1, F2.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to; 0 if not line-anchored.

claim.description: One sentence: what is wrong. No restating of the diff.

evidence.description: <=1 line of concrete evidence (quoted code, call site, failing input -> wrong output).

root_cause.description: The cause that produces the symptom, not the place the symptom shows up.

pre_existing.description: true = the defect exists independently of this diff. Pre-existing defects are INFO at most, UNLESS this change is what makes them wrong.

confidence.description: 0..1 confidence that this is a real defect.

layer.description: Which layer owns the root cause. config-table => the table owner edits the source sheet and re-exports; asset => the asset owner edits the prefab; never compensate downstream.

how.description: Concrete instruction: what to change and to what. Root-cause fix only - no nil guards, try/catch, special-case branches or compensating calls that mask the symptom.

risk.description: What this fix could break, and what must be re-checked after it.
